sentences.en: The drunken man grasped my collar and swore at me.
sentences.zh: 那个醉汉抓住我的衣领骂我。

sentences.en: I grasped the whole meaning of the book by reading.
sentences.zh: 通过阅读，我彻底理解了这本书的内容。

sentences.en: Sometimes I can't really grasp the meaning of a word.
sentences.zh: 有时候我无法真正理解一个词的意思。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：他见到她宛如抓住（grasp）一根救命稻草（grass）
